title: February event: a tic-tac uses hills to hide from the sensors

tellings.quote: And, for example, during our February event we had an object of the 2nd class, which demonstrated very strange behavior, which you have never seen before didn't see. He actually used hills to hide from us and disappear from our main sensors.
But on the fifth the day the obstacles were constant throughout two hours.
tellings.difference: Adds day-five two hours of interference and a manta ray also hiding behind terrain, with Jordan credited.
tellings.link_reason: Day five interference with a class 2 tic-tac and manta ray hiding behind terrain matches the February tic-tac using hills to hide from sensors.

as_told.title: Day five: two hours of interference, then a class 2 'tic-tac' and a 'manta ray' found hiding behind terrain
as_told.place_text: Skywatcher field site, about 800 m up and 800 m away

plain: At a February 2025 field event run by Skywatcher, a private company that tries to call in UFOs, an object shaped like a Tic Tac (a white oval, like the mint) is said to have used the hills to hide from the team's sensors. James Valor, a team member who was there, says this "object of the 2nd class" behaved in a way never seen before: "He actually used hills to hide from us and disappear from our main sensors." Another Skywatcher member who was there adds that on the fifth day the interference with their equipment went on for two hours. That member says an object shaped like a manta ray also hid behind the terrain, and credits a teammate named Jordan Jose. To the team, it suggests the objects know they are being watched and act on it.
